summary: Iteration 6: Admin panel + quiz mode-cleanup. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (stats, users search incl. regex-safe, premium toggle on/off + /auth/me reflection, invalid id 404, grant existing -> 'granted', grant non-existent -> 'pending' and auto-applied on register (grant removed after), remove pending, 403 for non-admin on all 5 admin endpoints, 401 unauth). ADMIN_EMAILS contains weronisia1987s@gmail.com; register() sets role=admin for ADMIN_EMAILS and startup promotes existing accounts (verified by code review only, owner email NOT registered). Frontend (375x667): ADMIN profile shows 'Panel administratora' row -> /admin shows stats, Nadaj Premium disabled when empty, pending grant message in Polish + pending list + remove works, search filters to ania, premium Switch toggles off/on and badge updates, grant to existing user shows 'Nadano Premium dla ...', back button returns to /profile. ania_t1 sees no admin row; /admin shows 'Brak uprawnień administratora.'. Quiz: life mode filled (has_idea, idea, new_directions) then back to step 1 and switched to search -> 10 steps, saved GET /api/profile contains only search-mode keys (no idea/new_directions/has_idea/loves). Minor issues only.

minor.issue: Email shorter than 3 chars (e.g. '@') returns 422 with Pydantic English detail array -> frontend shows generic 'Coś poszło nie tak. Spróbuj ponownie.'; also validation only checks '@' presence ('a@' accepted and stored as pending grant).

active=false sets premium=None unconditionally, which also wipes a paid (monthly/yearly) subscription; switching back on converts it to plan 'gift'. Consider only revoking gift plans or warning admin.

ui_bugs.issue: On deep-link to /admin (no history) router.back() does nothing - user stays stuck on /admin. Use same fallback as header: router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/(tabs)'). Button also lacks testID.

integration_issues.issue: toggle() swallows API errors (.catch(() => {})) with no user feedback or loading state; Switch has no optimistic update so it snaps back until refetch completes.

issues: Search input fires /admin/users request on every keystroke (no debounce)
Off-state Switch (white thumb on light grey track) has low contrast
pending_grants stat returned by API is not displayed
